about: A listener with a low-key, after-hours bias: minor-key harmony, warm restrained top end, a groove that sits back instead of pushing. Modeled taste, not a measurement of any real person.
values: space over density — the best bars leave room
a groove you feel before you count
harmony that moves, even if it moves twice a bar
top end warm enough to live with at 1 a.m.
dislikes: hats that tick like a clock
a mix with one flat dynamic level
three-chord loops that never resolve anywhere
